answer.rationale: Finance’s 18% cost reduction mandate is non-negotiable and the incumbent has explicitly refused to renegotiate this cycle (memory_c4). Renewing with the incumbent (memory_c1) preserves integration stability but fails the cost objective. The low-cost vendor’s quote meets the mandate, and memory_c2 demonstrates their proven operational capability (sharp unit-cost reduction, quick onboarding, accurate invoicing). With the primary contract expiring in 14 days and the line at 94% capacity with no buffer, a guarded test is impractical; a standard experiment via a short-term primary switch to the low-cost vendor satisfies the mandate while retaining contractual flexibility to revert if delivery risk materializes.
